name: Ikusa Miko Akari ~Akki Ninshin Ryoujoku no Utage~
original_name: 戦巫女あかり～悪鬼妊娠凌辱の宴～
source:
A battling shrine maiden is a virgin who uses her holy power to fight against the teachings of the demons.
Akari is able to view her holy power as a halberd, and makes a living defeating evil spirits in various places for local warlords.
Travelling together with her band of female warriors, they would topple the demons that disturbed the peaceful world of Bikor, and save its inhabitants.
They were supposed to be a ray of light, hope in the darkness.
But when the people she wished to protect are taken hostage by the demons, Akari is led straight into their trap.
What awaited her was days of constant violation, until her orifices were overflowing.
Her little sister Koyomi, an apprentice shrine maiden, and the female warrior Shizuka, also fell in the hands of the merciless demons.
Stained and disgraced, Akari endured the treatment plotting revenge against the demons.
But her heart goes in the opposite direction, and she ends up seeking to server the demons with her body, instead...

[From [url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE033069.html]dlsite[/url]]
translation:
戰鬥巫女是一位處女，她利用自己的神聖力量對抗惡魔的教義。
明里能將自己的神聖力量化為長戟，並以替各地領主驅除邪靈維生。
與她的女戰士隊伍一起旅行，她們四處討伐在比科爾作亂的惡魔，並拯救其居民。
她們原該是黑暗中的一束光，給人帶來希望。
但當她想要保護的人被惡魔劫為人質時，明里直接落入了他們的陷阱。
此後數日，惡魔不停地強暴她，直到體液從她身上的孔穴裡溢出來。
她的妹妹歷美（巫女學徒）和女戰士靜也落入了無情的惡魔手中。
蒙受玷汙與羞辱的明里，忍受著折磨，密謀向惡魔復仇。
但她的心卻走向了相反的方向，她最後竟渴望用自己的身體侍奉惡魔……
